speech.heard: Even in Australia, 11.1% of women have anemia. In India, it's 53.7%. Wealthy nations aren't immune. The UK has 13.6%, and the USA has 15%. Nigeria rises to 37.9%. The climb steepens. Benin has 50%. Ivory Coast 51.4%, Mauritania 54.5%, and Mali 56.5%. At number one, Gabon has 59.9%, the world's highest. That is four times what the USA has. How common is anemia among women in your country?
